summary: Completed comprehensive backend API testing for Calorie Tracker. Wrote pytest-based test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering auth, profile, foods, meals, water, progress, workouts, and dashboard. All 26 tests pass against external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: Does not require authentication — anyone can call it; harmless but semantically should at least no-op. Current impl simply deletes cookie and returns 200.
Cookies are set with Secure + SameSite=None which require HTTPS; fine in production but won't persist on http://localhost. Not a bug for deployed preview URL.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Consider FastAPI lifespan context.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 466 lines — acceptable for MVP but approaching threshold; consider splitting auth, meals, workouts into separate routers as the app grows.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login. Playbook suggests 5-attempt lockout — not implemented. Low priority for MVP but worth noting.
seed_admin is not idempotent for password changes: existing admin row is never updated if ADMIN_PASSWORD env changes. Only creates if missing.
CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo; explicit origin list recommended for cookie-based auth. Bearer token path works fine.
calculate_bmr_tdee_macros uses defaults silently when profile fields are None — users who haven't completed profile still get targets. Consider requiring profile completion for accurate dashboards.
auto-estimate for workouts ignores user weight even though it's read (variable unused) — comment says 0.1 kcal/kg/rep but implementation uses flat 0.15 per sets*reps.
Dashboard 'remaining' computes target - consumed + burned; consider clamping to avoid negatives UI-side.
No input validation on meal servings/calories being negative; Pydantic should add ge=0 constraints.
test_credentials: admin@calorie.app / Admin@123 (works). Dynamic test users created via register with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Per-test custom_foods / meals / water / progress / workouts records created under a fresh TEST_ user registered each session. Data is user-scoped; no pollution of admin account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints listed in the review request are verified. Auth uses Bearer token or cookie (cookie priority in get_current_user). Re-use /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py as regression suite. A fresh user is registered each session to keep tests isolated; TestAuth.test_me_without_token_401 uses plain requests.get (no shared session) because login cookies persist in the shared Session fixture.
